root_cause_summary: The prior worker report relied on stale or incomplete dispatch-audit artifacts and missed the higher-authority committed live telemetry row showing Telegram photo success ID 58 at 2026-07-08T20:37:40+07:00.
The live runner allowed dispatch_live to proceed without an explicit run-bound operator approval marker, a topic hash, or a Telegram payload hash approval.
The Telegram adapter could be called directly by the runner or scheduler with dry_run=false and no adapter-level approval-marker or duplicate guard.
Telegram caption construction allowed weak output to collapse into a generic read-more line plus canonical URL when the variant body was empty or too thin.
The Telegram adapter unit test wrote fake success telemetry ID 999, making telemetry ambiguous unless test and real runtime rows were distinguished.

repairs_implemented.summary: New credential-free public dispatch freeze guard with run_id, topic_hash, approval marker, payload hash, duplicate URL/media/topic checks, and Telegram preview-only body detection.
Telegram post/photo/comment/edit now freeze before credential lookup or network when dry_run=false and approval context is missing or mismatched.
Live dispatch now requires an explicit operator approval marker and optional fixed run id before any platform loop; Telegram gets a second per-payload guard before adapter send.
Incident duplicate ledger blocks the Crude/WTI Substack canonical URL before future Telegram adapter sends.
Tests now prove non-dry-run Telegram freezes without approval and mocked uploads isolate telemetry.
Tests now cover missing approval marker, Telegram preview-only captions, duplicate canonical URL guard, and no adapter call before freeze.

known_validation_failure_not_fixed_in_th: python -m pytest tests/test_security_scans.py -q fails because editorial_quality_audit_v6.py is not in the existing forbidden-import allowlist. The new guard module was changed to avoid forbidden urllib imports; the remaining failure is outside the Telegram incident freeze patch.
generated_drift_handling: Generated test drift was stashed as incident-freeze-test-generated-drift and excluded from commit scope.

remaining_manual_audit_requirements: Operator/Jim must manually audit the visible Telegram duplicate posts and decide whether to delete them; this task did not delete or edit public Telegram content.

Before any future public 8-platform candidate, create an explicit approval marker bound to the exact run_id, topic_hash, and Telegram payload_hash after editorial, media, duplicate, Telegram visual, and Substack public-readback gates pass.
Do not run fresh public dispatch until the security scan allowlist drift is addressed or explicitly waived with repo authority.
